scope: command responses typed response ownership and independently adopted signed HTTP command application; unchanged API v10 commands/interactions and Swift structured cancellation.
reviewedContracts: Slash-command messages use callback type 4; deferred channel messages use type 5 followed by the explicit edit-original-response endpoint.
Initial responses must be admitted within three seconds and continuation tokens have a fifteen-minute lifetime; an expired or uncertain initial send is never blindly retried.
Only EPHEMERAL is admitted on a deferred channel-message acknowledgement; its visibility cannot change when completing the original response.
Interaction callbacks retain independent admission and are exempt from the ordinary application global rate limit.
Signed HTTP ingress verifies exact request bytes; receipt mode and listener lifecycle remain application-owned.
Swift tasks use cooperative cancellation; typed adapters check cancellation around user work and preserve existing responder ownership rather than replaying mutations.

Swift 6.4 host features and Swift Testing async/await, test suites and expectation guidance were checked against official language, release and testing documentation; target concurrency settings remain unchanged.
qualification: Affected official-source review only; no new Discord wire operation, permission or intent. Local signed exchange and normalized-context tests do not establish live Discord, platform, production, capacity or full dsl qualification.
